description: This file defines the `FreeMarkerViewHandler` class, which manages the rendering of Freemarker templates within the OFBiz web application framework. It handles initialization, context preparation, and rendering of templates, integrating various OFBiz components and utilities.

classes.name: FreeMarkerViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler class that integrates FreeMarker template engine with the OFBiz framework to render dynamic web pages.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Freemarker configuration with cache storage and template loading directory.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares the context map for rendering a template, injecting OFBiz components, request/session objects, parameters, and tag libraries.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes and outputs a specified Freemarker template, handling errors related to template processing and output stream.
